document_representation: one normalized PageRecord text field per physical PDF page
experiment_stage: failure-driven query-token deduplication ablation on development_tune; no locked-test access
page_score: BM25 score of the full page text
retrieval_scope: pages within the question's known PDF document
tokenizer: Unicode letters and numbers; casefolded; punctuation/underscore boundaries; keep stopwords; retain only the first occurrence of each query token
